1.17 Finalization and image categorization

image_categories.py ARCHIVE compares DNG raw and auxiliary data after byte preservation completes. Exact whole-file matches can reuse that stronger byte identity; changed copies use the Python image comparison; missing references remain missing_reference. DNG_IMAGE_WORKERS controls the 1–36 image pool and DNG_IMAGE_RATE_MIB controls its pacing estimate. Different encoded images can still require substantial decoding memory.

finalize_year.py ARCHIVE validates completed year coverage, recovery records, metadata index integrity, batch checksums, image report coverage, saved originals or delta reconstruction, and source/reference identities. It writes verification.json, initially marking validation unfinished before any final acceptance. Inspect its actual issues and constituent reports. Metadata warnings, image differences and recoverable exact originals are separate facts, not one boolean to infer from a log line.

finalize_preservation.py is a retained single-archive finalization tool. export_verified.py exports only eligible raw-equal Python results for specified roots into the Rust TSV format. sample_storage_ratio.py samples archive storage ratios; it is an estimate over that archive, not a predicted universal saving.

uv run python finalize_preservation.py archives/source
uv run python export_verified.py reports/full/cache.sqlite3 reports/python-equal.tsv \
  --left-root /media/source/foto --right-root /media/reference/foto
uv run python sample_storage_ratio.py archives/source --output archives/storage-pilot

The single-archive finalizer expects the completed byte/metadata/XMP archive layout, not an arbitrary comparison report. The year finalizer additionally expects the year workflow’s provenance and tools layout. Both set safe_to_delete_source false; validation is archive evidence, not automatic deletion approval. Finalizers take their archive as a positional argument; they are not argparse --help interfaces. The export and sampling tools do provide --help. Export refuses to overwrite its output. There is no source photo deletion command in this release.
